jobs.title: IRT Project Manager, Remote US
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The IRT Project Manager is accountable for the client’s study specific Interactive Response Technology (IRT) implementation, ongoing conduct support, closeout and decommission. Provides subject matter expertise, leads study specific implementation, ensures on time delivery, and remediation of support issues.

Summary Of Responsibilities

Lead study-specific IRT Implementation Teams, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders including Clinical Trial Supply, Global Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, and vendors.
Create and manage IRT-related timelines and deliverables.
Conduct internal review meetings for vendor-written specifications and integration documents.
Plan, facilitate, and lead IRT study review meetings.
Ensure completion and approval of all IRT documentation, including specifications.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the IRT vendor for study-specific matters.
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations such as GxPs and ICH E6.
Provide guidance to the IRT Implementation Team on optimal system utilization.
Act as a subject matter expert on IRT best practices and share lessons learned across teams.
Define and complete initial documentation for scope of work requests from vendors.
Review and provide expert input on User Requirement Specifications and other IRT-related documents.
Review and approve UAT schedules aligned with URS.
Create study-specific IRT Test Plans and test scripts.
Facilitate UAT execution, coordinate issue resolution with vendors, and ensure proper documentation.
Define and oversee data exchange requirements between IRT and other systems.
Collaborate with stakeholders to determine integration solutions.
Manage initial and ongoing testing to ensure efficient and error-free data transfers.
Guide study teams on site-initiated data changes and vendor implementation.
Facilitate collection of closeout deliverables from IRT vendors.
Maintain a study-specific issue and risk log, documenting root causes, corrective actions, and preventive measures.
Advise on system changes post-launch to ensure alignment with study and program needs.
Manage study-specific IRT contracts, budgets, and change orders.
Support the Global IRT Lead in process governance and standardization.
Maintain consistency in IRT terminology, functionality, and reporting across studies.
Assist in metrics collection and reporting.
Recommend improvements to quality procedures and best practices.
Conduct or develop IRT-related training for internal teams.
Foster collaboration across internal stakeholders including Clinical Trial Supplies, eClinical Technology, Global Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Clinical Quality, Regulatory, and Outsourcing.
Provide regular updates to the Line Manager and escalate issues as needed.
Perform all other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required)

University / college degree (life sciences, health sciences, information technology or related subjects preferred) or a certification in allied health professions from an appropriate accredited institution.
Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.
Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

Experience (Minimum Required)

5–6 years of relevant experience in clinical systems project management, with a strong focus on or IRT and/or eCOA platforms
Hands-on experience in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including planning, execution, defect tracking, and system go-live support.
Proven ability to manage outsourced technology vendors and collaborate with sponsors and cross-functional teams.
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and detail-oriented approach to issue resolution and system validation.
Effective oral and written communication skills for stakeholder engagement, documentation, and reporting.
Solid understanding of the clinical trial lifecycle, including system implementation, data flow, regulatory compliance, and TMF documentation.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment with minimal supervision.
Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards.
Demonstrated self-motivation, accountability, and ownership of assigned tasks.
A cooperative and team-oriented mindset, with a willingness to support peers and contribute to shared goals.

Pay Range:
$110,000-$125,000

Benefits:
All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data. Regular, full-time or part-time employees working 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(K), Paid time off (PTO) or Flexible time off (FTO), Company bonus where applicable.

jobs.title: Web Dev Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join Our Dynamic Team as a Web Development Project Manager : Help Empower Healthcare Professionals Worldwide!

Location:
Lebanon – Remote
Employment:
Full-time
Working Hours:
10:00 am – 6:00 pm Sydney time
Compensation: Up to US$2,500 per month
depending on experience and assessment.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized and proactive Web Development Project Manager
to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time. You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who does more than simply update tasks. You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish
, following up with team members, solving problems and escalating risks before they become issues.

Please note:
We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency
is also highly preferred.

What You Will Do

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.
Develop clear project timelines, milestones, priorities and deliverables.
Coordinate work across different teams, including design, development, marketing, content and other operational functions.
Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.
Conduct regular project follow-ups and ensure outstanding tasks continue moving forward.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and potential delays early and take action to resolve them.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our project management systems.
Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines.
Communicate project progress, risks, delays and required decisions clearly to management.
Run project meetings and ensure actions, owners and deadlines are clearly documented.
Follow up with team members on outstanding deliverables and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed deadlines.
Work closely with management to prioritize projects and allocate resources effectively.
Improve existing workflows, processes and project management systems.
Develop and maintain project documentation, SOPs and reporting where required.
Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete.

What We Require

Minimum 4 years of professional website development project management experience.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Strong experience working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate project records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication skills and confidence following up with team members and stakeholders.
Ability to identify problems early and propose practical solutions rather than simply escalating issues.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Technically fluent in dev workflows, including sprint planning, QA processes, and coordinating between design, development, and client teams.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Experience using project management platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or similar
.
Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.

Highly Regarded

Experience working in a digital marketing agency, technology company or similar fast-paced digital environment
.
Experience managing website, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, design or development projects.
Experience with Monday.com
.
Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
Experience developing processes, workflows and SOPs.
Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification
.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:
Projects are delivered on time and important deadlines are rarely missed.
Management has clear visibility over the status of every project.
Team members know exactly what they are responsible for and when it is due.
Delays and bottlenecks are identified before they become major problems.
Project information is accurate and consistently maintained.
You actively drive projects forward rather than waiting for others to provide updates.
Processes become more organized and efficient as a result of your involvement.

The Person We're Looking For

You don't need to be reminded to follow something up. If a deadline is approaching, you already know about it and are working with the relevant person to make sure it is delivered.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging unrealistic timelines and holding people accountable while maintaining positive working relationships.
Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality
. When a project is assigned to you, you take responsibility for moving it forward and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Meaningful perks that reflect our commitment:

Competitive salary, inclusive of a monthly retention bonus.
Remote position (work from anywhere)
, full-time, and long-term
Annual compensation review
Fitness subsidy for 12 months to support your well-being.
Birthday leave, so you can celebrate and enjoy your special day off!
We observe local public holidays, allowing team members to rest and celebrate their national holidays.
15 days of Paid time off, ensuring team members have time to relax and recharge.
Global exposure and friendly work environment
Opportunity to learn new techniques & tools with a young and dynamic team
Lead performance with autonomy and visibility across departments.
Remote-first, collaborative culture that values initiative and outcomes.

Our Commitment

Mediboost is proudly an equal-opportunity employer.
We celebrate diversity, welcome individuality, and create a space where every voice is heard and valued.

jobs.title: Install Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

MAKE A DIFFERENCE AT OCHINOCHIN is a nonprofit leader in health care innovation and a trusted partner to a growing national provider network, delivering the clinical insights and tailored technologies needed to expand patient access, strengthen care teams, and improve the health of rural and medically underserved communities.
We are hiring for a number of new positions to meet increasing demand. When you choose to join OCHIN, you have the opportunity to continuously grow your skills and do meaningful work to help fulfill our vision of good health and well-being for everyone.

At OCHIN, we value the unique perspectives and experiences of every individual and work hard to maintain a culture rooted in our values.

Founded in Oregon in 2000, OCHIN employs a growing virtual workforce of more than 1,200 skilled professionals, working remotely across 49 states. We offer a generous compensation package and are committed to supporting our employees’ entire well-being by fostering a healthy work-life balance and opportunity for professional advancement. We are curious, collaborative learners who strive to live our values every day. OCHIN is excited to support our continued national expansion and the increasing demand for our innovative tools and services by welcoming new talent to our growing team.

Position Overview

The Project Manager
supports OCHIN’s mission by driving the successful scoping and execution of projects, such as Epic implementations and enhancements, third-party vendor implementations, and internal initiatives, to ensure successful execution and resource management across cross-functional teams. This role involves creating and executing project plans, consulting senior leadership, fostering collaboration across the organization, gathering and analyzing data for potential integrations, and supporting the efficient delivery of integrated products and services. Additionally, the role balances competing priorities, navigates technical and business constraints, and partners with internal and external stakeholders to solve complex challenges.

Essential Functions

Lead cross-functional projects from initiation through completion, aligning timelines, priorities, and outcomes to organizational goals.
Manage resources and workload effectively by balancing competing priorities and ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones.
Facilitate clear and impactful communication by tailoring messages to diverse audiences, facilitating alignment, providing project updates, and guiding stakeholders through project risks and decisions.
Collaborate across members, teams and vendors to resolve challenges proactively, foster mutual accountability, and ensure successful project outcomes.
Analyze and identify opportunities for improvement by optimizing processes, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement across teams, projects, and solutions.
Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

2+ years of experience in project coordination or management, business analysis, or technical solution roles preferred
Experience leading or supporting cross-functional projects, preferably in healthcare, IT, or a related field preferred
Familiarity with Epic or other EHR systems, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar tools is a plus
PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification preferred
Epic certification or healthcare-related credentials (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) are a plus but not required

Physical Requirements/Work Environment

Constant interpersonal skills, teamwork, and customer service. Frequent creativity, mentoring, presentations/teaching. Occasional decision making and independent judgment or action.
Reading, speaking, writing, and understanding English.
While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; stand and walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms.
This position requires a virtual home-office environment, working remotely.
The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers and mobile devices.
Travel is required to support OCHIN’s business requirements for go-live installations or training which may require travel by air, vehicle, or train.

Work Location and Travel Requirements

OCHIN is a 100% remote organization with no physical corporate office location. Employees work remotely from home and many of our positions also support our member organizations on-site for new software installations. Nationwide travel is determined based on OCHIN business needs. Please inquire during the interview process about travel requirements for this position. Work from home requirements are:

Ability to work independently and efficiently from a home office environment
High Speed Internet Service
It is a requirement that employees work in a distraction free workplace
Travel required up to 20% nationally for on-site Go Live support based on business requirements for OCHIN
(OR) Travel may be required nationally based on business requirements for OCHIN

We offer a comprehensive range of benefits. See our website for details: https://ochin.org/careerCOVID-19 Vaccination Requirement To keep our colleagues, members, and communities safe, OCHIN requires all employees—including remote employees, contractors, interns, and new hires—to be vaccinated with a COVID-19 vaccine, as supported by state and federal public health officials, as a condition of employment. All new hires are required to provide proof of full vaccination or receive approval for a medical or religious exemption before their hire date.

Equal Opportunity Statement

OCHIN is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills for the benefit of our staff, our mission, and the communities we serve. As an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, OCHIN, Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, marital or civil union status, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristics. All aspects of employment are based on merit, performance, and business needs.

Base Pay Overview
OCHIN uses broadened pay ranges to support equitable and market-aligned compensation practices. Pay information by position level is listed below. The final offer will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant skills, certifications, education, experience, training, responsibilities, internal equity, and market data.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Quantitative - Market Research (Remote)
jobs.description:
Company Description

M3 is the global leader in digital solutions in healthcare. We work with a range of sectors including healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and charities; services provided to these sectors include market research, medical education programs, promotional programs, clinical development, job recruitment and clinic appointment services. M3 has grown by more than 20% year-on-year for the past 15 years, achieving over 1 billion dollars in revenue annually.

Founded In 2000, With Start-up Investment Capital From Sony, M3’s Mission Is To Make Use Of The Internet To Increase, As Much As Possible, The Number Of People Who Can Live Longer And Healthier Lives, And To Reduce, As Much As Possible, The Amount Of Unnecessary Medical Costs. Key Achievements Of M3 Inc. Include

Named in Fortune’s 2020 ‘Future 50’ list, ahead of Facebook and Amazon
Ranked in Forbes’ 2020 Global 2000 list of the world’s largest public companies
M3 is the only company incorporated after the year 2000 to be included in the Nikkei 225 Index
Listed in Forbes’ ‘Asia’s 200 Best Over a Billion’ in 2019
In 2020 M3 founded the ‘M3: Stop COVID-19 Fund’ and pledged one billion yen to support COVID-19 related initiatives

M3’s legacy lies in the power of trusted physician platforms. Around the world, M3 organizations leverage these highly engaged digital communities to deliver medical education, job placement, and market research, to improve global patient outcomes.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Quantitative Project Manager
at M3 Global Research
, an M3 company.

About The Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Mission:

The mission of the Senior Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

Duties Include

Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.
Work directly with various teams to setup and test survey links and redirects, prepare and send sample, conduct quality/audit checks, managing respondent inquiries and honorarium and all other components of online research.
Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
The candidate must have at least 5+ years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
The candidate must be a self-motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
The candidate must have well-developed analytical and problem solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present as well as proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. The candidate must have the ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
The candidate must have basic math skills and be able to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
The candidate must have very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and be a quick learner of new technologies/software.
The candidate must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
The candidate must have the ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on-time in a fast-paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time.

Benefits

Additional Information

A career opportunity with M3USA offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

Health and Dental
Life, Accident and Disability Insurance
Prescription Plan
Flexible Spending Account
401k Plan and Match
Paid Holidays and Vacation
Sick Days and Personal Day

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

About The Opportunity

At Machinify, we’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize our clients’ financial outcomes today and drive down healthcare costs tomorrow. As part of the Enterprise Implementations team, the Implementation Manager drives end‑to‑end implementation of healthcare technology, analytics, and payment integrity solutions. This role is responsible for onboarding new clients, supporting product and service expansions, managing complex data integrations, and ensuring that projects meet timelines, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations.

Serving as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation lifecycle, this role partners closely with client stakeholders and Machinify Product, Technology, Data Engineering, Analytics, Client Success, and Operations to deliver high‑quality implementations that create measurable value for health plan partners.

What You’ll Do

Lead end‑to‑end implementation cycles including discovery, data readiness, configuration, integration, UAT, go‑live, and post‑launch transition.
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, RAID logs, risk mitigation plans, and status reports.
Facilitate internal and external project meetings, including kickoffs, milestone reviews, and working sessions.
Oversee cross‑functional project teams to ensure timely completion of tasks and proactive issue resolution.
Identify and mitigate risks; escalate blockers to leadership as needed.
Ensure implementation activities meet quality standards, data security requirements, contractual obligations, and industry regulations (e.g., HIPAA, CMS).
Serve as the primary point of contact during implementation, ensuring a responsive, solution‑oriented client experience.
Provide clear and timely updates, action items, and next steps.
Prepare and deliver client‑facing materials including status decks, project updates, training materials, and process documentation.
Present complex or technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, including client leadership.
Coordinate data mapping, validation, ingestion, and quality checks across healthcare file types (claims, eligibility, provider, pharmacy, etc.).
Transcribe requirements into actionable JIRA or ADO tickets, supporting grooming and sprint planning with Engineers.
Demonstrate strong understanding of analytics workflows, data mining concepts, audit/recovery processes, and payment integrity operations.
Support integrations related to complex claims audits, COB, Subrogation, data mining services, payment integrity algorithms, and other related workflows.
Design, refine, and optimize operational workflows based on client requirements and product capabilities.
Diagnose operational or system‑related issues and collaborate internally to resolve them.
Develop user guides, SOPs, quick‑start guides, implementation plans, and process maps for client and internal use.
Maintain clear, auditable documentation for all implementation activities.
Deliver training on platform features, workflows, AI‑driven tools, and processes to clients and internal teams.
Provide feedback to improve implementation methodologies, tools, templates, and overall process efficiency.
Support onboarding, coaching, and knowledge transfer for new Implementation team members.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance scalability, quality, and efficiency.

What Experience You Bring (Role Requirements)

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare, IT, Data, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience).
3–5+ years of implementation or project management experience in healthcare technology, payment integrity, insurance services, analytics, or related fields.
Experience with healthcare data structures and exchange file types (claims, eligibility, provider, pharmacy) and associated integration workflows.
Strong understanding of data mining concepts, analytics workflows, and how data supports audit or recovery outcomes.
Experience implementing both SaaS products and services‑based solutions.
Proficiency with JIRA, Smartsheet, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Experience with AI tools to support efficiency and accuracy
Excellent verbal and written communication and the ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.
Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and critical‑thinking skills with the ability to manage data‑heavy implementations.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
Strong relationship‑building skills and a customer‑centric mindset.
High degree of professionalism, reliability, and consistency in a client facing role.
Working knowledge of CMS requirements, healthcare regulations, and HIPAA.
Ability to collaborate across distributed teams, lead through influence, and work independently with minimal oversight.
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar certification preferred.

Pay range
: $120,000 - $140,000 (base)

This is an exempt position. Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location.

What We Offer

Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
Top Medical/Dental/Vision offerings

Additional health and wellness benefits and perks

jobs.description:
Job Description

The future is what you make it!

When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who make the things that make the future. That means changing the way we fly, fueling jets in an eco-friendly way, keeping buildings safe and even making it possible to breathe on Mars. Working at Honeywell isn’t just about developing cool things. That’s why our employees enjoy access to dynamic career opportunities across different fields and industries.

Be part of a team assessing and driving achievement of program specific performance within Honeywell Aerospace. You will be the engineering project leader and be the primary decision maker for engineering program cost, schedule and engineering issues. You will lead a team in the prioritization of work packages, design goals and objectives, and drive overall program performance for Avionics (Epic, Apex, and/or Anthem) programs with a focus on leading cross functional/product/COE integrated avionics systems.

Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead Avionics Engineering Programs across multiple Centers of Excellence
Work with CBT, PMO, and other leadership
Manage engineering cost and schedule
Assess and drive achievement of programs
Strategy development
Early problem detection and course correction.
Annual Operating Plan
Manage short and long term staffing needs
Involvement with program pursuits and launches
Manage Program Metrics

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Description

Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As a member of the Environmental team, you will support environmental programs aimed at ensuring compliance with air quality regulations and standards in the Americas while also enabling AWS's growth around the world.

As an Air Program Manager, your primary focus will be serving as the air compliance subject matter expert (SME) across an Americas sub-region, providing programmatic oversight and ensuring alignment of compliance practices across all AWS data centers. You will build regional-level compliance infrastructure (frameworks, standards, tools, and visibility) and provide functional direction to the Regional Environmental Engineers (REEs) who execute compliance at their sites. You will work closely with the Environmental team, engineering, operations teams, vendors, and other partners to ensure consistent application of air quality compliance programs, particularly those related to Tier 4 compliant diesel generators. Your role will involve providing technical expertise on local, state, and federal air regulations and creating strategies for continuous improvement in air compliance management. As the team's air compliance SME, you will support REEs across the region to resolve complex air compliance challenges and drive environmental performance. You will also play a key role in standardizing incident response and reporting protocols related to air compliance events.

The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of air compliance and regulatory requirements in North America, demonstrated ability to develop and standardize complex compliance systems across multiple jurisdictions, and proven experience leading air quality initiatives that drive environmental performance and sustainability. The ideal candidate will excel at providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong attention to technical details and have a track record of successfully collaborating with diverse stakeholders to implement environmental compliance programs at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Build and lead regional air quality compliance programs, providing standards and functional direction to in-region engineers across North and South America
Set and maintain the regional framework for compliance with federal, state, and local air quality regulations related to emergency backup power systems
Ensure compliance with EPA regulations including 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII (Standards of Performance for Stationary Compression Ignition Internal Combustion Engines)
Develop and implement air quality monitoring programs and compliance tracking systems for permitted backup power generation (Tier 2/Tier 4 diesel generators, natural gas, etc)
Establish standardized emissions testing programs and protocols that engineers and testing firms execute at their sites
Provide technical guidance on air quality compliance requirements
Support emergency response planning related to air quality incidents
Collaborate with the air permitting team and in-region engineers to ensure operational compliance with existing permit conditions
Stay current with evolving air quality regulations and industry best practices for diesel generator management
Develop and deliver air quality compliance training for relevant staff
Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for air quality compliance

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree
5+ years with air permitting and/or compliance experience at local, state, federal levels

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

Description

Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As a member of the Environmental team, you will support environmental programs aimed at ensuring compliance with air quality regulations and standards in the Americas while also enabling AWS's growth around the world.

As an Air Program Manager, your primary focus will be serving as the air compliance subject matter expert (SME) across an Americas sub-region, providing programmatic oversight and ensuring alignment of compliance practices across all AWS data centers. You will build regional-level compliance infrastructure (frameworks, standards, tools, and visibility) and provide functional direction to the Regional Environmental Engineers (REEs) who execute compliance at their sites. You will work closely with the Environmental team, engineering, operations teams, vendors, and other partners to ensure consistent application of air quality compliance programs, particularly those related to Tier 4 compliant diesel generators. Your role will involve providing technical expertise on local, state, and federal air regulations and creating strategies for continuous improvement in air compliance management. As the team's air compliance SME, you will support REEs across the region to resolve complex air compliance challenges and drive environmental performance. You will also play a key role in standardizing incident response and reporting protocols related to air compliance events.

The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of air compliance and regulatory requirements in North America, demonstrated ability to develop and standardize complex compliance systems across multiple jurisdictions, and proven experience leading air quality initiatives that drive environmental performance and sustainability. The ideal candidate will excel at providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong attention to technical details and have a track record of successfully collaborating with diverse stakeholders to implement environmental compliance programs at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Build and lead regional air quality compliance programs, providing standards and functional direction to in-region engineers across North and South America
Set and maintain the regional framework for compliance with federal, state, and local air quality regulations related to emergency backup power systems
Ensure compliance with EPA regulations including 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII (Standards of Performance for Stationary Compression Ignition Internal Combustion Engines)
Develop and implement air quality monitoring programs and compliance tracking systems for permitted backup power generation (Tier 2/Tier 4 diesel generators, natural gas, etc)
Establish standardized emissions testing programs and protocols that engineers and testing firms execute at their sites
Provide technical guidance on air quality compliance requirements
Support emergency response planning related to air quality incidents
Collaborate with the air permitting team and in-region engineers to ensure operational compliance with existing permit conditions
Stay current with evolving air quality regulations and industry best practices for diesel generator management
Develop and deliver air quality compliance training for relevant staff
Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for air quality compliance

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree
5+ years with air permitting and/or compliance experience at local, state, federal levels

Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws

Join Honeywell’s high-visibility F-35 Navigation Team as a Senior Program Manager and help shape the future of mission-critical aerospace navigation systems. Reporting to the F-35 Program Director, you will lead cross-functional teams responsible for planning and executing DMS projects that sustain the viability of the Inertial Navigation and Tactical Navigation Systems on the F-35, while also supporting Trade Study and Special Test Equipment programs. Own project scope, objectives, and deliverables while partnering closely with engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, and customer-facing teams

About Us

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Electrical Products and Services, Data Center Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Sr. Technical Program Manager drives the at-scale global implementation of the newest generations of data center electrical products and electrical distribution infrastructure technologies from concept through deployment. Just as critically, the Sr. TPM is the drum beat for product engineering and design and for New Product Introduction (NPI) into at-scale manufacturing facilities — synchronizing engineering, design, qualification, and manufacturing readiness so products transition smoothly from development into high-volume global production. This role provides a unique opportunity to engage with advanced infrastructure solutions and the exceptional people that develop them. Electrical Products and Services (EPS) within AWS Data Center Engineering designs, qualifies, manufactures, and deploys the standardized electrical products that distribute power throughout our data centers at hyperscale. Our team owns the low-voltage power distribution path from the electrical room to the rack. We productize this infrastructure to standardize and optimize power distribution package, automation, and footprint, qualify it with our suppliers, introduce it into at-scale manufacturing, , and deploy and sustain it across the global fleet (AMER, EMEA, and APAC), driving continuous generational improvements in cost, capacity, and reliability along the way.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. These technologies are essential for meeting our customers' expectations for service and value and meeting Amazon's goals for efficiency, speed, and reliability as we continue expanding our data centers at hyper-scale speed. We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in data center technology. You should be comfortable driving execution in a fast-paced and often uncertain environment, and delivering results, while demonstrating leadership, technical competence, and a bias for action.

As An Ideal Candidate, You

Are passionate about understanding customers' and stakeholders' needs
Have passion for program delivery, infrastructure execution, and low voltage products
Are great at solving problems and removing blockers
Have the ability to manage multiple programs/projects at different stages while staying organized
Earn trust and build relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Engineering, Product Development, Finance, Operations)
Are comfortable addressing and resolving ambiguity
Recognize and appreciate diversity of thought and perspectives

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for engineering, product development, finance, integration, and operation of these complex technology programs. You prioritize your activities to keep programs on track, identify and resolve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions that are most impactful for delivery success.

This role requires travel of 20%+ to manufacturing facilities, AWS engineering hubs, data center sites, and supplier locations to drive NPI, qualification, and at-scale deployment.

We have an immediate opening for a Sr. Technical Program Manager in Northern Virginia, Austin, and Columbus. Atlanta is a fourth and less-preferred option. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale size, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities

Lead the cross-functional programs that design, develop, launch, and support LV power distribution, monitoring, and switching products (e.g. UL891) with $1B+ USD annual production, owning the end-to-end schedule, scope, and execution.
Set the cadence for product engineering and design teams, driving NPI milestones and introduction into at-scale manufacturing facilities, and ensuring manufacturing readiness, qualification, and ramp targets are met.
Engage with internal and external teams and partners to align program requirements, dependencies, and delivery commitments against rack and DC design roadmaps.
Build detailed program plans, defining milestones, deliverables, and success criteria across engineering, qualification, and deployment workstreams.
Coordinate between multiple teams to manage interdependencies, sequence critical path work, and secure the budget and resources required to execute product roadmaps on time.
Identify, communicate, and mitigate program risks and blockers, and report technical status, trade-offs, and escalations to Sr. Management.
Own and drive the complete delivery lifecycle from program kickoff through implementation, wide-scale deployment, and eventual deprecation, ensuring quality and operational readiness at each phase.
Work independently in a high-pressure environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist.

About The Team

*Why AWS*

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated professional track record in Product Development, Data Center/ Mission-Critical Facilities (Design, Operation, Planning), or Low Voltage Power Distribution products.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager II - Laser Communications
jobs.description:
About Rocket Lab

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we’re building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, laser communication terminals, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER II - LASER COMMUNICATIONS

Laser communication is the backbone of the constellations of today and tomorrow, and demand for it is growing fast. We are scaling industry-leading optical communication terminals to meet it: high-performing, affordable, and available at the volume commercial and government constellation operators need. Based at Rocket Lab’s global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, you are the customer’s champion and the delivery lead for our optical communication terminal programs. You own the customer outcome: the day-to-day relationship, delivery commitments and schedule at rate, milestone and acceptance reviews, risk, and program health. You build on a proven, standard terminal product and partner closely with our Product team on configuration, pricing, and new customer needs. You’ll work alongside the teams that build the spacecraft, the components, and the rockets, so the people you need to solve a problem are down the hall, not under another contract. This is a high-impact, customer-facing role: you connect the customer, our engineering teams, the production line, and the business across two continents, and you’re the person our customers count on.

What You’ll Get To Do

Lead Delivery: Lead terminal programs from award through qualification, production at rate, delivery, and on-orbit checkout, across current-generation production and next-generation variants. Hold each program to its plan and deliver on schedule, technical performance, and every customer commitment.
Lead the Team of Teams: Run multiple concurrent customer programs, work closely with Chief Engineers on link performance, data rate, SWaP, environmental qualification, and optical terminal interoperability, and dive in personally on the problems that matter most to delivery.
Deliver at Rate: Own each program’s delivery profile and protect it. Spot yield, supplier, and test-capacity risk early and drive it to closure with Operations and the Product team.
Forge the Supply Chain: Partner with Supply Chain to manage critical suppliers as strategic partners, building the relationships and accountability that keep every customer delivery on schedule.
Run the Program Lifecycle: Own program startup and baselining, milestone and qualification reviews, export and ITAR obligations with Trade Compliance, customer acceptance, and closeout across our U.S. and European sites.
Champion the Customer: Be the trusted point of contact for customers through milestone reviews, interoperability campaigns, acceptance, and delivery. Partner with BD & Strategy on proposals and with the Product team on pricing and configuration, bringing the voice of the customer to every decision.
Raise the Bar: Mentor the people around you, set a high standard for how we show up for customers, and help develop the program leaders who will run our next generation of laser communications programs.

QUALIFICATIONS YOU’LL BRING AS A SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER II

Engineering Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or Math.
Technical Depth: Working understanding of free-space optical or RF communications: link budgets, pointing, acquisition, and tracking, modems and coding, and space or airborne environmental qualification.
8+ years in space, aerospace, or photonics hardware programs, with multiple full program cycles. We weight the hardest thing you’ve shipped over the count.
Customer Delivery: A track record of leading a complex hardware program to delivery (customer, schedule, risk, and acceptance) and carrying it across the finish line under real pressure.
Production Delivery: Evidence you’ve moved real hardware from prototype to qualified, rate-production delivery to customers.
Program Financials: Experience managing program cost, EAC, and customer contract changes in partnership with finance and product teams on a program of meaningful scale.
Proof Point: You’ve delivered hardware at rate to a demanding customer and kept their trust through a hard moment, such as a slip, a test failure, or a contract change.
Clearance: U.S. Person status required (ITAR/EAR); ability to obtain a security clearance preferred.

These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have

Domain Authority: Direct experience with optical inter-satellite links or optical ground or airborne terminals.
Production Velocity: A proven playbook for taking low-volume, hand-built optical or electro-optical hardware into high-rate production without sacrificing reliability.
Constellation Fluency: Experience delivering to large commercial or defense constellation programs.
Customer Leadership: Experience as the primary customer interface for constellation operators or satellite primes, from kickoff through acceptance.
Global Leadership: Experience leading program work across geographically dispersed sites, including export-control and dual-use compliance.
Advanced Technical Credibility: A Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Optics/Photonics, Physics, or a related field.
Systems & Toolchain Fluency: You speak systems engineering (trade studies, interface control, requirement integrity) and use Jira, Confluence, and ERP/MRP to keep program health visible at speed.
AI Fluency: You put AI tools to work in day-to-day program management, from schedule and risk analysis to status reporting and customer communications, so you and your team spend more time on the problems that matter.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base Pay Range (CA Only): $153,000 USD - $229,500 USD

What To Expect

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important Information

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER I - LASER COMMUNICATIONS

Laser communication is the backbone of the constellations of today and tomorrow, and demand for it is growing fast. We are scaling industry-leading optical communication terminals to meet it: high-performing, affordable, and available at the volume commercial and government constellation operators need. Based at Rocket Lab’s global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, you are the customer’s champion and the delivery lead for our optical communication terminal programs. You own the customer outcome: the day-to-day relationship, delivery commitments and schedule at rate, milestone and acceptance reviews, risk, and program health. You build on a proven, standard terminal product and partner closely with our Product team on configuration, pricing, and new customer needs. You’ll work alongside the teams that build the spacecraft, the components, and the rockets, so the people you need to solve a problem are down the hall, not under another contract. This is a high-impact, customer-facing role: you connect the customer, our engineering teams, the production line, and the business across two continents, and you’re the person our customers count on.

What You'll Get To Do

Lead Delivery: Lead terminal programs from award through qualification, production at rate, delivery, and on-orbit checkout, across current-generation production and next-generation variants. Hold each program to its plan and deliver on schedule, technical performance, and every customer commitment.
Lead the Team of Teams: Run multiple concurrent customer programs, work closely with Chief Engineers on link performance, data rate, SWaP, environmental qualification, and optical terminal interoperability, and dive in personally on the problems that matter most to delivery.
Deliver at Rate: Own each program’s delivery profile and protect it. Spot yield, supplier, and test-capacity risk early and drive it to closure with Operations and the Product team.
Forge the Supply Chain: Partner with Supply Chain to manage critical suppliers as strategic partners, building the relationships and accountability that keep every customer delivery on schedule.
Run the Program Lifecycle: Own program startup and baselining, milestone and qualification reviews, export and ITAR obligations with Trade Compliance, customer acceptance, and closeout across our U.S. and European sites.
Champion the Customer: Be the trusted point of contact for customers through milestone reviews, interoperability campaigns, acceptance, and delivery. Partner with BD & Strategy on proposals and with the Product team on pricing and configuration, bringing the voice of the customer to every decision.
Raise the Bar: Mentor the people around you, set a high standard for how we show up for customers, and help develop the program leaders who will run our next generation of laser communications programs.

You'll Bring These Qualifications As Senior Program Manager i

Engineering Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or Math.
Technical Depth: Working understanding of free-space optical or RF communications: link budgets, pointing, acquisition, and tracking, modems and coding, and space or airborne environmental qualification.
5+ years in space, aerospace, or photonics hardware programs, with multiple full program cycles. We weight the hardest thing you’ve shipped over the count.
Customer Delivery: A track record of leading a complex hardware program to delivery (customer, schedule, risk, and acceptance) and carrying it across the finish line under real pressure.
Production Delivery: Evidence you’ve moved real hardware from prototype to qualified, rate-production delivery to customers.
Program Financials: Experience managing program cost, EAC, and customer contract changes in partnership with finance and product teams on a program of meaningful scale.
Proof Point: You’ve delivered hardware at rate to a demanding customer and kept their trust through a hard moment, such as a slip, a test failure, or a contract change.
Clearance: U.S. Person status required (ITAR/EAR); ability to obtain a security clearance preferred.

These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have

Domain Authority: Direct experience with optical inter-satellite links or optical ground or airborne terminals.
Production Velocity: A proven playbook for taking low-volume, hand-built optical or electro-optical hardware into high-rate production without sacrificing reliability.
Constellation Fluency: Experience delivering to large commercial or defense constellation programs.
Customer Leadership: Experience as the primary customer interface for constellation operators or satellite primes, from kickoff through acceptance.
Global Leadership: Experience leading program work across geographically dispersed sites, including export-control and dual-use compliance.
Advanced Technical Credibility: A Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Optics/Photonics, Physics, or a related field.
Systems & Toolchain Fluency: You speak systems engineering (trade studies, interface control, requirement integrity) and use Jira, Confluence, and ERP/MRP to keep program health visible at speed.
AI Fluency: You put AI tools to work in day-to-day program management, from schedule and risk analysis to status reporting and customer communications, so you and your team spend more time on the problems that matter.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base Pay Range (CA Only): $125,300 USD - $187,850 USD

What To Expect

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Pratt Miller is a product development company in motorsports, defense, and mobility industries providing clients with product engineering and low-volume production solutions. The leader will focus on building core competencies that deliver exceptional value to our customers, creating a competitive edge for the Warfighter. Manage technical development, scheduling, and resolve engineering issues.

jobs.description:
About this position:
Information System Security Manager in Colorado Springs, CO

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities are intended to present a descriptive list of the range of duties performed for this position and are not intended to reflect all duties performed within the job. Other duties may be assigned. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Applicants will be notified via email or phone within ten business days regarding application status.

This position is contingent upon award of contract.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Serve as the Information System Security Manager (ISSM) responsible for overseeing cybersecurity, information assurance, and Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance for assigned information systems and programs.
Develop, implement, and manage the organization's cybersecurity program to ensure compliance with DoD, Intelligence Community (IC), Federal, and organizational requirements.
Lead RMF activities throughout the system lifecycle, including system categorization, control implementation, assessment, authorization, continuous monitoring, and risk management.
Oversee the preparation, maintenance, and submission of cybersecurity authorization packages, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Security Control Traceability Matrices (SCTMs), and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
Advise Program Managers, Authorizing Officials (AOs), Information System Owners (ISOs), and senior leadership regarding cybersecurity risks and compliance requirements.
Manage vulnerability assessment, remediation, continuous monitoring, and cybersecurity risk mitigation efforts.
Ensure compliance with NIST, DoD, CNSSI, ICD, and organizational cybersecurity policies and directives.
Supervise and provide technical guidance to Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), Information System Security Engineers (ISSEs), System Administrators, and cybersecurity personnel.
Coordinate security testing, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, audits, and inspections.
Review and approve system security configurations, architecture changes, software implementations, and security control modifications.
Oversee implementation of cybersecurity controls across classified and unclassified information systems.
Support incident response activities, cybersecurity investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.
Develop cybersecurity policies, procedures, standards, and training programs.
Provide cybersecurity metrics, compliance reporting, and risk briefings to leadership and government customers.
Participate in Configuration Control Boards (CCBs), technical reviews, engineering working groups, and program management reviews.
Ensure all personnel operating information systems comply with security policies, training requirements, and acceptable use standards.

Required (Minimum Necessary) Qualifications

Education Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. Additional years of qualifying experience may be substituted for education requirements.
Minimum of 7 years of experience in cybersecurity, information assurance, information security, systems administration, systems engineering, or related technical disciplines.
Minimum of 3 years of experience serving in an ISSM, ISSO, cybersecurity lead, or comparable cybersecurity management role.
Experience implementing and managing the Risk Management Framework (RMF) for DoD or Federal information systems.
Experience developing and maintaining Authorization to Operate (ATO) packages and related cybersecurity documentation.
Experience overseeing vulnerability management, compliance assessments, and security control implementation.
Experience managing cybersecurity compliance requirements for classified and unclassified systems.
Experience leading teams and coordinating cybersecurity activities across multiple organizations.
Strong analytical, leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
Experience briefing cybersecurity risks to senior leadership and government stakeholders.
Must possess or be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics

Thorough knowledge of Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes and NIST cybersecurity standards.
In-depth understanding of NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-37, DoD Cybersecurity Policies, CNSSI requirements, and Intelligence Community directives.
Knowledge of system security architecture, network security, cloud security, virtualization, and enterprise cybersecurity operations.
Familiarity with vulnerability management, security assessments, auditing, and continuous monitoring programs.
Understanding of security engineering principles and lifecycle cybersecurity integration.
Knowledge of incident response, configuration management, and security operations processes.
Ability to analyze complex technical risks and communicate recommendations to leadership.
Strong documentation, policy development, and technical writing skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects, systems, and cybersecurity initiatives simultaneously.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, cybersecurity tools, compliance platforms, and security management systems.
Knowledge of organizational procedures and workflows – understanding how work moves through a company.
Basic knowledge of relevant technologies or tools – e.g., Microsoft 365, communication platforms, or industry‑standard software.
Knowledge of customer service practices – principles of providing quality service and managing inquiries professionally.
Knowledge of data privacy and confidentiality principles – awareness of proper handling of sensitive information.
Communication skills (written and verbal) – ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
Time management and prioritization – balancing multiple tasks and meeting deadlines.
Problem‑solving and critical thinking – analyzing issues and selecting appropriate solutions.
Interpersonal and teamwork skills – building rapport and collaborating effectively with others.
Attention to detail – producing accurate, error‑free work.

Preferred

Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility or current TS/SCI clearance.
DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level III or IAM Level III certification requirements satisfied.
CISSP, CISM, CAP, CASP+, GSLC, SecurityX, or equivalent advanced cybersecurity certification.
Experience supporting Air Force, Space Force, Army, Navy, SOCOM, Intelligence Community, or other Federal Government environments.
Experience supporting classified information systems, SCI environments, and Special Access Programs (SAPs).
Experience managing cybersecurity programs supporting cloud environments such as Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, or hybrid architectures.
Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture implementation and cybersecurity modernization initiatives.
Experience with ACAS, HBSS/ESS, Splunk, Microsoft Defender, eMASS, Xacta, or comparable cybersecurity platforms.
Experience supporting DevSecOps and secure software development initiatives.
Prior experience serving as an ISSM, Senior ISSO, Cybersecurity Manager, Cybersecurity Program Manager, or Security Architect.
