jobs.title: Senior Security Manager, Amazon Vulnerability Management
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Security's Vulnerability Management Service (AVMS) manages the entire vulnerability management (VM) program across Amazon’s retail business special teams, and AWS. AVMS operates at an unprecedented asset scale, as well as diversity of business lines ranging from Cloud, Health Care, Payments, Devices, Fulfillment, and even drones!

AVMS’s mission is to be Earth’s best VM team, keeping customers safe and enabling software teams to build cool new innovations securely. We are looking for a Senior Manager of Security Engineering to take on this mission and our scale to make a profound impact across Amazon and its external customers.

Are you interested in building and leading a focused top-notch security team responsible for securing

assets from IoT to Drones? Do you get excited about the challenge of harmonizing differentiated security objectives into common solutions and processes? Do you like to analyze, play with data, and innovate with AI? Are you excited about getting into deep details of how software, hardware, and devices work as well as how vulnerabilities impact them? If so, this role is for you! This role requires understanding how software is built, businesses operate, to scale processes, assess risk, and make deep data driven decisions to manage vulnerabilities. Further, this role requires an innovator that wants to change the status quo to improve outcomes for customers.

Key job responsibilities

As the Senior Security Manager in AVMS organization you will be responsible for the remediation operations, process, and management of security findings produced by Amazon Vulnerability Management Service (AVMS) team.

You will create vision, charters, mechanisms, processes, and solutions that ensure 100% of vulnerabilities that could impact Amazon customer’s are mitigated and remediated. You will work cross functionally across software teams you own and others to create security solutions for Amazon. You will work within and across multiple security organizations to drive outcomes. You will have an infectious desire for securing customers, and analyzing through data which actions need to be taken every day.

You will lead an innovative team of security practitioners to ensure security risk is mitigated and then ultimately removed from the Amazon environment.

A day in the life

Your work will be dynamic and impactful. You will start your day with metrics and insights that lead the direction of your teams daily execution. You’ll attend cross functional meetings and support sessions designed to resolve and prevent vulnerabilities from taking hold in the Amazon environment. Further, you’ll spend a portion of your time sitting with other peer security leaders to understand how you can shift your organization to help them achieve their goals of securing the latest and greatest Amazon products. Should it be required, if danger comes knocking, you will be there to have your teams jump in to protect our customers.

The majority of your creative time will be focused on scaling vulnerability management across differentiated technologies, businesses lines, and business objectives.

About The Team

The AVMS organization is an international team with sites covering Seattle, Austin, Sydney, New York, Arlington, and London. The team is a mix of security engineers, software engineers, and data roles chartered together to tackle the problem of high scale vulnerability management.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of industry work with hands-on security engineering experience
10+ years of risk assessment and enabling organizations making security decisions experience
10+ years of team management and building (including coaching and mentoring) experience
10+ years of communicating technical concepts to a non-technical audience experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
Experience communicating technical concepts to a non-technical audience
Experience with hands-on security engineering
Experience in risk assessment and enabling organizations to make security decisions
Experience in team management and building (including coaching and mentoring)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of information security risk-based prioritization
Knowledge of information security technologies such as security design review, threat modeling, risk analysis, and software testing techniques
Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
Experience architecting, securing, and operating Amazon Web Services

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.description:

About The Position

Riverside University Health System (RUHS) seeks candidates for an RUHS Compliance Program Manager position. This role supports the development, coordination, implementation, and oversight of RUHS corporate compliance programs and activities. The selected candidate will supervise support staff, ensure adherence to applicable regulations, and perform related duties as required. Current certification in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC)
is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities Include

Supporting compliance with federal, state, and county laws and regulations, including HITECH.
Providing subject matter expertise on medical privacy and information security.
Overseeing staff and managing program activities as assigned.
Assisting in achieving compliance goals and strategic objectives.

The RUHS Compliance Program Manager is a journey-level manager classification reporting to the RUHS/County Compliance and Privacy Officer. Incumbents are expected to perform complex and increasingly responsible work with minimal supervision, contributing to the design, execution, and monitoring of effective compliance programs. This position is distinct from the RUHS/County Compliance and Privacy Officer, which entails broader responsibilities in directing and managing regulatory compliance programs.

This class has been deemed eligible for the Performance Recognition Plan as set forth under Article 3, Section 311(C) of the County Management Resolution. Program eligibility requires employees to be in a leadership position, manage other employees or programs, and have significant influence on the achievement of organizational objectives.

Why RUHS Medical Center?

Riverside University Health System-Medical Center is nationally recognized for its innovative, progressive care and is considered one of the top employers in the region. The 439-bed Medical Center is a designated Stroke Center, Level I Trauma Center, and home to the only Pediatric ICU in the area.

For more information about RUHS Medical Center, please visit ruhealth.org .

Examples Of Essential Duties

Perform audits to assess compliance with various laws, regulations, policies, and standards such as those related to healthcare fraud, waste and abuse, billing and coding, clinical documentation, privacy and information security, research and ethics; maintain a system of reporting that provides timely and relevant information of all aspects of compliance issues.
Participate in appropriate level of response, develop corrective action plans and conduct compliance investigations while maintaining confidentiality of information reported, as appropriate.
Evaluate departmental continuous readiness to achieve compliance in the areas of healthcare privacy and security; assist in the development and implementation of privacy policies, procedures and breach notification as necessary.
Develop and implement policies and procedures for filing and investigation of complaints related to HIPAA/HITECH Privacy, Breach Notification Rules and related County guidelines and procedures.
Develop and monitor policies and procedures that establish standards for ensuring patient privacy protections, including by providing guidance to individual employees and departments on the HIPAA Privacy Rule, as appropriate.
Document and retain all complaints received as required by HIPAA/HITECH; establish and maintain a mechanism for tracking and reporting the investigation and resolving such complaints.
Develop and administer training for RUHS staff to promote awareness of compliance to regulatory standards.
Provide guidance and assistance to departments on a variety of privacy and compliance auditing, and internal control matters; document findings and prepare reports.
Supervise, assign, review, and evaluate the work performed by staff; direct the day-to-day operations of support staff.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree, preferably with a major in business administration, public administration, public health nursing, finance, accounting, or a closely related field to the assignment. (A master's degree from an accredited college or university in any of the aforementioned majors is preferred.) Possession of current Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC) certification is preferred.

Experience:
Three years of professional, journey-level experience in healthcare compliance, which includes internal auditing experience and experience in the development and implementation of HIPAA and/or privacy compliance programs.

Knowledge of:
Information security; theory, principles and practices of general healthcare; governmental accounting, budgeting and auditing; HIPAA privacy and security rules and regulations; privacy laws, rules and regulations relating to information and security; federal, state and local codes, rules and regulations including healthcare fiscal operations; the methods of developing systems forms for various types of accounting records and reports; information systems and their application to accounting operations; the principles, methods and techniques of public administration, personnel and business office management; the principles and techniques of supervision.

Ability to:
Develop and implement compliance and auditing programs; apply legal and administrative compliance policies to hospital or health systems; analyze data, draw logical conclusions, conduct independent audits, reviews, and make evaluations to ensure compliance issues and concerns are appropriately evaluated, investigated and resolved; recommend effective courses of action; communicate effectively in oral and written form; establish and maintain effective working relationships; conduct independent systems analyses of complex business processes.

Provide leadership and guidance to program teams fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
Direct the work and approve resource requirements and program estimates while leading integrated program teams utilizing Integrated Product Delivery & Support (IPDS) Process. 
Generate and implement program plans and business requirements within approved budget and schedule constraints.

Proven ability to develop and manage complex program plans including scheduling, budgeting, and resource allocation.
Experience with risk management and mitigation strategies specific to aerospace defense projects.

WE VALUE

Strong leadership and decision-making skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities tailored to complex defense projects.
Adaptability to dynamic environments and passion for continuous improvement and innovation.
7 years of experience or knowledge of the Aerospace industry specifically in navigation

Strong communication (oral and written) and executive presentation skills

jobs.description:
About The Job

Project Manager

NSF MSRI-1 Project

Position Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of a National Science Foundation (NSF)-funded Mid-Scale Research Infrastructure (MSRI-1) project, including technical scope, cost, schedule, risk, and stakeholder engagement. Working in close collaboration with the Principal Investigator and the science and technical teams, the PM ensures that all project activities are planned and executed in alignment with NSF’s Research Infrastructure Guide (RIG), the approved Project Execution Plan (PEP), and award terms and conditions. The PM maintains the performance measurement baseline across cost, schedule, and scope through the project change control process; oversees risk identification and mitigation; and serves as a primary point of coordination among the institution, NSF program officers, sub-awardees, and other project stakeholders. The PM is accountable for the quality and timeliness of all project controls outputs, compliance reporting, and lifecycle documentation required to meet NSF oversight expectations throughout the full duration of the award.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership

Oversee the day-to-day operations of the project office.
Sets and maintains a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture.
Directs and coordinates the project controls team.
Oversees recruitment, onboarding, and professional development of project staff.
Leads regular project team meetings, technical reviews, and schedule update sessions; prepares and distributes meeting minutes and action item logs.
Collaborates with University support services (e.g., Sponsored Projects Administration, Business Administration, Information Technology, and Human Resources) for smooth project operation.

Project Planning and Execution

Spearheads Project Execution Plan revisions, partnering with the PI and technical team to implement key revisions, including the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), contingency management, scope management, scheduling, and risk assessment sections.
Develops and oversees the project schedule, including milestones, activities, and assigned resources.
Oversees execution of the integrated project plan and monitors progress against scope, schedule, and milestones.
Manages cross-functional dependencies and competing priorities.
Leads planning for major reviews, milestones, and deliverables, including documentation of operational and technical requirements and interfaces.
Identifies and manages emerging risks, issues, and resource constraints, and is accountable for timely resolution of any items identified.

Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting

Serves as primary conduit between the PI, science and technical teams, and NSF program officers.
Manages activities and communications across the University, NSF, sub-awardees, partner institutions, and the science community.
Develops and delivers project status briefings and presentations for internal leadership, external stakeholders, and NSF.
Prepares and submits progress reports, including monthly project status reports, variance analyses, and other documentation required by NSF award terms.
Leads preparation for external reviews and oversight activities.\
Represents the project at workshops, reviews, conferences, and planning meetings, as appropriate.
Maintains strong relationships with strategic project stakeholders and partners.

Project Management and Control

Leads project budgeting, forecasting, and resource management.
Monitors and controls project scope, cost, and schedule against the approved Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB).
Manages the project change control process to maintain baseline integrity.
Leads Control Account Management (CAM) meetings and monitors project performance.
Reviews all project controls deliverables, including schedules, cost reports, and Earned Value Management (EVM) analyses, for quality, accuracy, and NSF compliance before distribution or submission.
Develops and manages the project Risk Register, including identifying, assessing, and mitigating project risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Maintains visibility of project risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, and action items.
Leads quality management across project deliverables and management processes.
Promotes continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and practices.
Accountable for compliance with NSF policies, the Research Infrastructure Guide, and award terms and conditions.
Oversees Environmental, Health & Safety compliance.
Accountable for data management and compliance with cyber security requirements.

Other Duties as Assigned

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

Primarily office-based with extended computer use
Frequent communication and collaboration with team members
Domestic and international travel may be required

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or related field and six (6) years of related work experience managing multi-million dollar projects and project teams. OR advanced degree plus at least four years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the interpersonal and leadership ability to effectively interface with a team of scientists, engineers, and project stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain budgets and project schedules in accordance with best practices, including ability to create a WBS dictionary, activity sequencing, critical path methodology, and resource loading. Proficiency in MS Project or Primavera for project scheduling is preferred.
Experience managing a federally funded research project, including familiarity with federal award terms, reporting requirements, and sponsor oversight processes. Prior experience with NSF-funded projects preferred but not required.
Sufficient technical knowledge of the subject matter domain to engage credibly with scientists and engineers, identify technically driven project risks, and communicate effectively across disciplines. Domain knowledge in earth sciences, drilling, or related fields is ideal but comparable experience in a technically complex research environment is acceptable.
Skilled at recording and controlling changes to the performance baseline (cost, scope, and schedule).
Able to identify and align project needs to the science mission and goals.
Working knowledge of Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS) and how to use it as an integrated management tool for successful project planning and execution.
Demonstrates knowledge of principles, methods, and tools for risk management.

About The Department

The Department of Earth & Environmental Sciences is a vibrant interdisciplinary department whose faculty’s research ranges from paleoclimate to deep earth dynamics. The Department is in the School of Earth & Environmental Sciences (www.cse.umn.edu/esci) which also includes the Institute for Rock Magnetism, the Continental Scientific Drilling Coordination Facility, the Minnesota Geological Survey, and the Polar Geospatial Center. The majority of the School resides in John T. Tate Hall on the Minneapolis campus, with some labs on the St. Paul campus. Other affiliated research units at the University include the Saint Anthony Falls Laboratory, the Institute on the Environment, and the BioTechnology Institute.

Pay And Benefits

$76,000 - $96,000 per year ; depending on education/qualifications/experience

Time Appointment:
100% Appointment

Faculty and P&A Staff

Continuous learning opportunities through professional training and degree-seeking programs supported by the Regents Tuition Benefit Program

Employee wellbeing program

Employee Transit Pass with free or reduced rates in the Twin Cities metro area

time, the initial pay may not reach the maximum of the range. This approach ensures

Conduct OPSEC assessments, surveys, and vulnerability analyses to identify critical information and potential adversary exploitation risks.

Knowledge of OPSEC processes, methodologies, and regulatory guidance.

Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Experience coordinating with government customers and senior leadership.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to independently manage multiple tasks and priorities.

Familiarity with Counterintelligence (CI), Information Security, Cybersecurity, Physical Security, and Personnel Security programs.

located in the United States to build and scale its go-to-market reporting and analytics function.

Automate recurring go-to-market analytics in partnership with decision intelligence teams, designing, refining, and testing AI agents for weekly reporting, campaign and sales play readouts, scoring-model evaluations, and anomaly detection.
Own marketing and go-to-market KPI definitions, calculation logic, and regular leadership reporting, providing clear narrative explanations of changes and underlying drivers.
Measure marketing campaigns and sales plays across the full lifecycle from first touch through closed-won deals using pre/post and cohort analyses to inform strategic resource allocation.
Develop standardized, reusable reporting templates for campaigns and sales plays with consistent attribution rules, time horizons, and definitions formatted for AI-assisted drafting.
Manage Dreamdata and refine attribution methodologies across multi-touch models, sourcing logic, sales development credit, and partner attribution, reconciling outputs with Salesforce and HubSpot to drive budget recommendations.
Evaluate and optimize marketing qualified lead (MQL), product qualified lead (PQL), and account intent scoring models, establishing automated tracking for precision, coverage, and conversion impact.
Define metrics and evaluate business development and partner performance, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, co-marketing initiatives, and tiered partner productivity.
Partner with data engineering and decision intelligence teams to define baseline go-to-market datasets, document semantic context for AI analytics agents, and resolve data quality issues at the source.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous or complex business inquiries into precise, structured analytical questions and constructively challenge misaligned premises before conducting analysis.
Comprehensive understanding of B2B revenue funnels (including MQL, SAL, SQL, and Closed Won stages) and the operational dynamics between marketing, product-led growth, partnerships, sales development, and account executive motions.
Advanced SQL proficiency within data warehouse environments and across core and custom Salesforce objects, including Leads, Contacts, Campaigns, Campaign Members, and Opportunities.
Proven experience auditing, cleaning, and reconciling disparate data systems to resolve discrepancies at the source.
Direct experience implementing, maintaining, or improving multi-touch attribution frameworks and reconciling attribution outputs with CRM data.
Experience evaluating and optimizing lead, PQL, or account scoring models, including measuring conversion rate impact.
Direct experience applying AI tools to analytics workflows, such as developing AI agents or agentic systems (e.g., Claude Code, MCP servers, n8n), automating analytical routines, and writing context and evaluation benchmarks.
Proven track record of building decision-grade business intelligence dashboards and regular reporting packages accompanied by executive-level commentary.
Demonstrated experience defining and standardizing business KPIs across systems to maintain organizational reporting consistency.

Preferred Qualifications

Approximately 3 to 5 years of marketing analytics, revenue analytics, go-to-market analytics, or comparable analytical experience within a B2B SaaS organization, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Program Manager – Strategic Initiatives
Location: Washington, DC
Schedule: Hybrid, with flexibility
Duration: 4-month contract, with potential for a longer-term opportunity
Target Start: Late November / Early December 2026

Position Overview
We are working with an organization seeking an experienced Program Manager to support high-priority strategic initiatives, executive-level projects, organizational governance, and cross-functional planning. This high-visibility role will partner closely with senior leadership and teams across the organization to coordinate complex initiatives, support decision-making, improve internal processes, and drive projects from planning through implementation.

A key focus will be supporting the organization's evolving approach to artificial intelligence, including governance and oversight processes, internal technology implementation, change management, and adoption initiatives. The Program Manager will also coordinate leadership and committee activities, contribute to policy and procedure development, and help connect priorities across departments.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, analytical, and comfortable operating with significant autonomy. They should be able to manage complex projects, anticipate challenges, exercise sound judgment, and communicate effectively with stakeholders ranging from project teams to executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Program and Project Management
Lead a portfolio of strategic and cross-functional initiatives from planning and design through implementation, evaluation, and closeout.
Develop project charters, work plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and success measures.
Monitor project progress, identify risks and roadblocks, manage competing priorities, and proactively recommend solutions.
Provide strategic and analytical support to leadership on organizational priorities, business challenges, and key initiatives.
Conduct research, environmental scans, and analysis to evaluate options, tradeoffs, risks, and potential impacts.
Develop project tracking tools, dashboards, templates, and reporting processes to improve visibility and accountability.

AI Governance and Technology Implementation
Coordinate AI governance and oversight activities, including committee operations, meeting agendas, minutes, decisions, recommendations, and action-item tracking.
Support the review and progression of AI use cases through established governance and approval processes.
Coordinate leadership discussions, working groups, and documentation related to responsible AI use, organizational policies, and oversight.
Support the implementation and organizational rollout of AI-enabled tools, including communications, training coordination, FAQs, user resources, and stakeholder engagement.
Track implementation progress, adoption metrics, user feedback, outstanding issues, and follow-up actions.
Partner with technical teams responsible for system configuration, security, and implementation to ensure alignment between technical work, organizational priorities, and governance requirements.
Help identify opportunities to improve AI adoption, internal processes, and the effectiveness of technology initiatives.

Executive and Committee Support
Prepare executive-level presentations, briefing documents, decision memos, talking points, status reports, and meeting materials.
Coordinate leadership meetings and committee activities, including scheduling, agenda development, documentation, decision tracking, and follow-up.
Support board-related working groups and governance initiatives, including preparing materials and coordinating priorities and deliverables.
Facilitate communication between leadership, committees, and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and timely information sharing.
Support annual and long-term planning activities, track strategic priorities, and prepare updates for leadership review.

Policy, Process Improvement, and Organizational Coordination
Support the development, review, documentation, and improvement of organizational policies, procedures, and workflows.
Identify opportunities to streamline processes, strengthen governance, clarify responsibilities, and improve operational efficiency.
Coordinate internal working groups and task forces focused on policy, planning, and organizational effectiveness.
Serve as a liaison across departments to connect related initiatives, clarify expectations, and maintain alignment on priorities.
Contribute to departmental planning, internal communications, and organization-wide initiatives as needed.
Document processes, decisions, and recommendations to support consistency, transparency, and effective execution.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field required; a master's degree in public health, public policy, public administration, health services, or a related discipline is preferred.
At least 6 years of progressively responsible experience in program management, project management, strategic planning, business operations, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience independently managing complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and high-level visibility.
Strong project management expertise, including work plans, timelines, deliverables, risk management, status reporting, and implementation tracking.
Experience preparing presentations, executive briefings, decision memos, and other polished written materials for senior leadership.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to research complex issues, evaluate options, identify implications, and recommend practical solutions.
Proven ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgment, anticipate challenges, and move initiatives forward without extensive day-to-day direction.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for audiences at different organizational levels.
Demonstrated ability to build relationships, facilitate meetings, and coordinate effectively across departments and stakeholder groups.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and SharePoint, along with familiarity with project management and collaboration tools.
Exceptional organization, attention to detail, follow-through, and discretion when handling sensitive information.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in healthcare, public health, health research, nonprofit, public policy, or public-sector environments.
A master's degree in public health, public administration, public policy, or a related field, particularly with an emphasis on systems thinking, organizational strategy, or policy.
Experience coordinating executive committees, board-related initiatives, governance workgroups, or leadership task forces.
Experience supporting AI governance, responsible AI use, technology implementation, organizational adoption, or change management.
Familiarity with policy and procedure development, organizational controls, or governance frameworks.
Experience coordinating organization-wide initiatives that require collaboration among leadership, communications, operations, and technical teams.
Technical AI expertise is not required. The priority is experience managing the strategy, governance, implementation, communications, and organizational considerations associated with complex initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile
The strongest candidate will be an independent, solutions-oriented program manager who can step into an active portfolio of initiatives and quickly establish priorities. They will bring strong organizational skills, sound judgment, critical thinking, and the confidence to work directly with senior leaders.
This person should be comfortable balancing detailed project coordination with broader strategic thinking, connecting the dots across departments, anticipating what comes next, and translating complex topics into clear plans and recommendations.

Additional Details
High-visibility opportunity to support strategic initiatives and work closely with senior leadership.
Flexible hybrid arrangement in Washington, DC.
Initial four-month contract, with the possibility of a longer-term opportunity depending on organizational needs and fit.
The team is hoping to bring someone on in late November or early December to allow for onboarding and knowledge transfer.
Candidates with experience in complex, mission-driven organizations and strong cross-functional project leadership skills are encouraged to apply.

Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As the team's air compliance SME, you will support REEs across the region to resolve complex air compliance challenges and drive environmental performance. You will also play a key role in standardizing incident response and reporting protocols related to air compliance events.

The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of air compliance and regulatory requirements in North America, demonstrated ability to develop and standardize complex compliance systems across multiple jurisdictions, and proven experience leading air quality initiatives that drive environmental performance and sustainability. Build and lead regional air quality compliance programs, providing standards and functional direction to in-region engineers across North and South America

Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws

jobs.title: Air Program Manager, AWS Environmental
jobs.description:
Description

Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As a member of the Environmental team, you will support environmental programs aimed at ensuring compliance with air quality regulations and standards in the Americas while also enabling AWS's growth around the world.

As an Air Program Manager, your primary focus will be serving as the air compliance subject matter expert (SME) across an Americas sub-region, providing programmatic oversight and ensuring alignment of compliance practices across all AWS data centers. You will build regional-level compliance infrastructure (frameworks, standards, tools, and visibility) and provide functional direction to the Regional Environmental Engineers (REEs) who execute compliance at their sites. You will work closely with the Environmental team, engineering, operations teams, vendors, and other partners to ensure consistent application of air quality compliance programs, particularly those related to Tier 4 compliant diesel generators. Your role will involve providing technical expertise on local, state, and federal air regulations and creating strategies for continuous improvement in air compliance management. As the team's air compliance SME, you will support REEs across the region to resolve complex air compliance challenges and drive environmental performance. You will also play a key role in standardizing incident response and reporting protocols related to air compliance events.

The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of air compliance and regulatory requirements in North America, demonstrated ability to develop and standardize complex compliance systems across multiple jurisdictions, and proven experience leading air quality initiatives that drive environmental performance and sustainability. The ideal candidate will excel at providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong attention to technical details and have a track record of successfully collaborating with diverse stakeholders to implement environmental compliance programs at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Build and lead regional air quality compliance programs, providing standards and functional direction to in-region engineers across North and South America
Set and maintain the regional framework for compliance with federal, state, and local air quality regulations related to emergency backup power systems
Ensure compliance with EPA regulations including 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII (Standards of Performance for Stationary Compression Ignition Internal Combustion Engines)
Develop and implement air quality monitoring programs and compliance tracking systems for permitted backup power generation (Tier 2/Tier 4 diesel generators, natural gas, etc)
Establish standardized emissions testing programs and protocols that engineers and testing firms execute at their sites
Provide technical guidance on air quality compliance requirements
Support emergency response planning related to air quality incidents
Collaborate with the air permitting team and in-region engineers to ensure operational compliance with existing permit conditions
Stay current with evolving air quality regulations and industry best practices for diesel generator management
Develop and deliver air quality compliance training for relevant staff
Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for air quality compliance

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree
5+ years with air permitting and/or compliance experience at local, state, federal levels

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
3+ years with engine specific regulations including 40 CFR 63 Subpart ZZZZ and 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Excellent Program/project management skills.

Own our research programs end to end as the primary point of contact for government program managers and contracting teams

Deliver contract requirements on time: CDRLs, monthly status and financial reports, technical reports, and final deliverables
Run the program cadence: weekly reviews, technical interchange meetings, milestone reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR), and status to leadership and customers
Run the risk, issue, and opportunity process and drive mitigations to closure
Coordinate engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and flight test, and deconflict shared people, hardware, and test assets between efforts
Manage scope changes, contract modifications, and follow-on work with our contracts and business development teams
Build the PMO tools and processes we will need as we add aircraft programs

7+ years of program management, with at least 4 years owning cost, schedule, and technical performance on aircraft, UAS, or other aerospace and defense hardware programs
Direct experience managing DoD research and development contracts (S&T, prototype, or 6.2/6.3 efforts)
Track record taking aircraft or aerospace hardware through build and test, ideally to first flight
Working knowledge of government contract execution: CDRLs, funded vs. ceiling value, modifications, and customer reporting
Hands-on with IMS development (MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet or similar), budget tracking, and EVM concepts
Ability to run several efforts at once and make clear priority calls when they compete
Clear, direct communicator who can brief an engineer, an executive, and a government program manager
U.S. person status as defined by ITAR, and ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Nice to have

Experience working with DoD research labs and innovation organizations
Program experience on Group 3 to Group 5 UAS, collaborative autonomy, or experimental aircraft
Experience with OTA, SBIR/STTR, or other rapid acquisition contract vehicles
Familiarity with airworthiness and flight test planning
Background at a startup or fast-scaling hardware company
Active Secret clearance or higher
PMP or DAWIA Program Management certification

new_jobs.title: Air Program Manager, AWS Environmental
new_jobs.description:
Description

Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As a member of the Environmental team, you will support environmental programs aimed at ensuring compliance with air quality regulations and standards in the Americas while also enabling AWS's growth around the world.

As an Air Program Manager, your primary focus will be serving as the air compliance subject matter expert (SME) across an Americas sub-region, providing programmatic oversight and ensuring alignment of compliance practices across all AWS data centers. You will build regional-level compliance infrastructure (frameworks, standards, tools, and visibility) and provide functional direction to the Regional Environmental Engineers (REEs) who execute compliance at their sites. You will work closely with the Environmental team, engineering, operations teams, vendors, and other partners to ensure consistent application of air quality compliance programs, particularly those related to Tier 4 compliant diesel generators. Your role will involve providing technical expertise on local, state, and federal air regulations and creating strategies for continuous improvement in air compliance management. As the team's air compliance SME, you will support REEs across the region to resolve complex air compliance challenges and drive environmental performance. You will also play a key role in standardizing incident response and reporting protocols related to air compliance events.

The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of air compliance and regulatory requirements in North America, demonstrated ability to develop and standardize complex compliance systems across multiple jurisdictions, and proven experience leading air quality initiatives that drive environmental performance and sustainability. The ideal candidate will excel at providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong attention to technical details and have a track record of successfully collaborating with diverse stakeholders to implement environmental compliance programs at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Build and lead regional air quality compliance programs, providing standards and functional direction to in-region engineers across North and South America
Set and maintain the regional framework for compliance with federal, state, and local air quality regulations related to emergency backup power systems
Ensure compliance with EPA regulations including 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII (Standards of Performance for Stationary Compression Ignition Internal Combustion Engines)
Develop and implement air quality monitoring programs and compliance tracking systems for permitted backup power generation (Tier 2/Tier 4 diesel generators, natural gas, etc)
Establish standardized emissions testing programs and protocols that engineers and testing firms execute at their sites
Provide technical guidance on air quality compliance requirements
Support emergency response planning related to air quality incidents
Collaborate with the air permitting team and in-region engineers to ensure operational compliance with existing permit conditions
Stay current with evolving air quality regulations and industry best practices for diesel generator management
Develop and deliver air quality compliance training for relevant staff
Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for air quality compliance

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree
5+ years with air permitting and/or compliance experience at local, state, federal levels

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
3+ years with engine specific regulations including 40 CFR 63 Subpart ZZZZ and 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Communication Proficiency
Decision Making

Teamwork Orientation
Thoroughness

Own project scope, objectives, and deliverables while partnering closely with engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, and customer-facing teams
Lead matrixed teams to deliver cost, schedule, technical performance, and quality commitments on programs that directly support the F-35 mission
Translate business objectives into clear execution strategies, practical plans, and measurable outcomes

Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance PM processes and practices

Work on a globally recognized aerospace platform with mission-critical technical impact

Access comprehensive benefits, including medical, vision, dental, mental health support, paid vacation, and retirement benefits as applicable by region

PMI certification or commitment to obtain certification within 6 months, sponsored by Honeywell Aerospace

Master’s degree in engineering or business
Honeywell Global PE/PM Academy graduation
Proven business and financial acumen
Aerospace background
Experience managing complex Government-funded, Cost-Plus programs
Demonstrated leadership, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to think strategically while tactically setting and achieving goals
Attention to detail and ability to effectively prioritize tasks
Adaptability and flexibility to manage changing project requirements
Experience with Honeywell’s IPDS process
Experience with resource-loaded scheduling and critical path analysis
Experience with Earned Value Management
Strong technical writing and executive presentation skills
Curiosity, passion for innovation, and a commitment to continuous learning
Proven track record of successfully completing complex engineering projects on time and within budget
Strong leadership and project management skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments
Experience in risk management and problem solving
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft
Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying

new_jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Honeywell’s high-visibility F-35 Navigation Team as a Senior Program Manager and help shape the future of mission-critical aerospace navigation systems. Reporting to the F-35 Program Director, you will lead cross-functional teams responsible for planning and executing DMS projects that sustain the viability of the Inertial Navigation and Tactical Navigation Systems on the F-35, while also supporting Trade Study and Special Test Equipment programs. This role offers meaningful technical complexity, strong executive exposure, and the opportunity to expand into additional Navigation programs across the LM Aero portfolio as capacity permits.

Responsibilities

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own project scope, objectives, and deliverables while partnering closely with engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, and customer-facing teams
Lead matrixed teams to deliver cost, schedule, technical performance, and quality commitments on programs that directly support the F-35 mission
Translate business objectives into clear execution strategies, practical plans, and measurable outcomes
Build and execute integrated project plans within approved budget, schedule, and resource constraints
Adhere to Honeywell’s Integrated Product Delivery & Support (IPDS) process and its phase gate reviews
Employ tools and processes for setting and maintaining robust project and technical baselines
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance PM processes and practices
Identify and mitigate risks; identify and propose opportunities
Engage stakeholders with clear issue summaries, practical options, and timely corrective-action recommendations
Communicate complex project, technical, and financial status with confidence to internal leaders, customer stakeholders, and executive audiences
Comply with OPSEC, CUI, and export regulations and laws
Update Earned Value metrics based on project execution
Ensure project billings are submitted on time

WHY JOIN HONEYWELL

Work on a globally recognized aerospace platform with mission-critical technical impact
Gain visibility with senior leadership, customers, and cross-functional aerospace teams
Build your career through professional development, leadership opportunities, and exposure to complex program execution
Access comprehensive benefits, including medical, vision, dental, mental health support, paid vacation, and retirement benefits as applicable by region

Qualifications

U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIREMENT

Must be a US Citizen due to contractual requirements.

The annual base salary range for this position is $173,000-$216,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell Aerospace considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

This position is incentive eligible

This position requires Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) certification, which certification of the two will be determined by the level of the position & meeting the minimum experience requirements of the certification. Candidates who do not currently hold the certification required for their position level must obtain the applicable certification within six (6) months of hire. The company will cover the cost of required training, certification, and/or recertification.

Must Have

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field
6+ years of engineering project management experience, ideally in complex technical or regulated environments
PMI certification or commitment to obtain certification within 6 months, sponsored by Honeywell Aerospace

We Value

Master’s degree in engineering or business
Honeywell Global PE/PM Academy graduation
Proven business and financial acumen
Aerospace background
Experience managing complex Government-funded, Cost-Plus programs
Demonstrated leadership, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to think strategically while tactically setting and achieving goals
Attention to detail and ability to effectively prioritize tasks
Adaptability and flexibility to manage changing project requirements
Experience with Honeywell’s IPDS process
Experience with resource-loaded scheduling and critical path analysis
Experience with Earned Value Management
Strong technical writing and executive presentation skills
Curiosity, passion for innovation, and a commitment to continuous learning
Proven track record of successfully completing complex engineering projects on time and within budget
Strong leadership and project management skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments
Experience in risk management and problem solving
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

About Us

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace Products And Services Are Found On Aircraft Across Commercial Aviation, Defense And Space. We Operate Through Three Business Areas

Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft
Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying
Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board

With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Benefits

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability coverage
401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
Employee assistance program and educational assistance
Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Electrical Products and Services, Data Center Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Sr. Technical Program Manager drives the at-scale global implementation of the newest generations of data center electrical products and electrical distribution infrastructure technologies from concept through deployment. Just as critically, the Sr. TPM is the drum beat for product engineering and design and for New Product Introduction (NPI) into at-scale manufacturing facilities — synchronizing engineering, design, qualification, and manufacturing readiness so products transition smoothly from development into high-volume global production. This role provides a unique opportunity to engage with advanced infrastructure solutions and the exceptional people that develop them. Electrical Products and Services (EPS) within AWS Data Center Engineering designs, qualifies, manufactures, and deploys the standardized electrical products that distribute power throughout our data centers at hyperscale. Our team owns the low-voltage power distribution path from the electrical room to the rack. We productize this infrastructure to standardize and optimize power distribution package, automation, and footprint, qualify it with our suppliers, introduce it into at-scale manufacturing, , and deploy and sustain it across the global fleet (AMER, EMEA, and APAC), driving continuous generational improvements in cost, capacity, and reliability along the way.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. These technologies are essential for meeting our customers' expectations for service and value and meeting Amazon's goals for efficiency, speed, and reliability as we continue expanding our data centers at hyper-scale speed. We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in data center technology. You should be comfortable driving execution in a fast-paced and often uncertain environment, and delivering results, while demonstrating leadership, technical competence, and a bias for action.

As An Ideal Candidate, You

Are passionate about understanding customers' and stakeholders' needs
Have passion for program delivery, infrastructure execution, and low voltage products
Are great at solving problems and removing blockers
Have the ability to manage multiple programs/projects at different stages while staying organized
Earn trust and build relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Engineering, Product Development, Finance, Operations)
Are comfortable addressing and resolving ambiguity
Recognize and appreciate diversity of thought and perspectives

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for engineering, product development, finance, integration, and operation of these complex technology programs. You prioritize your activities to keep programs on track, identify and resolve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions that are most impactful for delivery success.

This role requires travel of 20%+ to manufacturing facilities, AWS engineering hubs, data center sites, and supplier locations to drive NPI, qualification, and at-scale deployment.

We have an immediate opening for a Sr. Technical Program Manager in Northern Virginia, Austin, and Columbus. Atlanta is a fourth and less-preferred option. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale size, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities

Lead the cross-functional programs that design, develop, launch, and support LV power distribution, monitoring, and switching products (e.g. UL891) with $1B+ USD annual production, owning the end-to-end schedule, scope, and execution.
Set the cadence for product engineering and design teams, driving NPI milestones and introduction into at-scale manufacturing facilities, and ensuring manufacturing readiness, qualification, and ramp targets are met.
Engage with internal and external teams and partners to align program requirements, dependencies, and delivery commitments against rack and DC design roadmaps.
Build detailed program plans, defining milestones, deliverables, and success criteria across engineering, qualification, and deployment workstreams.
Coordinate between multiple teams to manage interdependencies, sequence critical path work, and secure the budget and resources required to execute product roadmaps on time.
Identify, communicate, and mitigate program risks and blockers, and report technical status, trade-offs, and escalations to Sr. Management.
Own and drive the complete delivery lifecycle from program kickoff through implementation, wide-scale deployment, and eventual deprecation, ensuring quality and operational readiness at each phase.
Work independently in a high-pressure environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist.

About The Team

*Why AWS*

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated professional track record in Product Development, Data Center/ Mission-Critical Facilities (Design, Operation, Planning), or Low Voltage Power Distribution products.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.
